title: Devices
count: {count} of {limit, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
hint: You can connect as many devices as you have slots. A device appears here when a VPN app refreshes the subscription. When every slot is taken, a new device gets no servers — remove one you no longer use here, or with /devices in the bot.
overLimitWarning: Devices over the limit get no servers. Remove one you no longer use or buy more slots below.
emptyBody: A device shows up here the first time a VPN app refreshes the subscription from your link.
unavailable: Could not load your devices. Check your connection and try again.
confirmBody: Within a few minutes the app on this device stops connecting. You can bring it back at any time: refresh the subscription in the app and it takes a free slot again.
hwidTip: INCY without HWID sending counts as one device however many phones use it. Turn on HWID sending in INCY's subscription settings and refresh the subscription — every device will then show up here on its own.
